title: A method, system and storage medium for constructing intra-cluster and extra-cluster aggregation cycles for cluster federated learning
assignee: Nanjing University of Posts and Telecommunications

pse.problem: The traditional centralized federated learning architecture has high global resource consumption due to multiple rounds of model upload and communication energy consumption of client local training. Also, the impact of non-independent and identically distributed data of clients affects training efficiency and convergence speed.
pse.solution_function: Constructs intra-cluster and extra-cluster aggregation cycles for clustered federated learning to reduce inter-cluster communication aggregations by setting multiple clusters and corresponding cluster heads. These cluster heads perform local averaging before global aggregation of the model. The mathematical relationship between inter-cluster and intra-cluster model communication aggregation periods is dynamically adjusted based on data distribution similarity.
pse.solution_structure: Multiple clusters, corresponding cluster heads, central server.
pse.solution_implementation: Dynamic adjustment of inter-cluster and intra-cluster model communication aggregation periods based on data distribution similarity. Local averaging by cluster heads before global aggregation.
pse.effect: Improves the efficiency of federated learning, accelerates model convergence, reduces global energy consumption and latency.
